newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LEONARDO SET TO LEAVE PSG FOR AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEONARDO SET TO LEAVE PSG FOR AC MILAN.

text.p: Brazilian playmaker Leonardo is set to leave Paris St Germain to join AC Milan, the French sports daily l'Equipe reported on Tuesday.
Barcelona and AC Milan were in the market for the 27-year-old international but l'Equipe said Leonardo had already agreed to sign for the Italian side.
Paris St Germain were reported to have demanded some 80
million francs ($18 million) to release the player.
It is believed that his departure could create an opportunity for compatriot Edmilson to join the Parisian side from Porto.
